entries.text: BenchBox now generates SingleStore queries in the SQLGlot `singlestore` dialect and Amazon Athena queries in the `athena` dialect, instead of `mysql` and `trino`; the platform manifest no longer carries `capabilities.query_dialect`. SingleStore queries write native `:>` casts and `NULLS FIRST` / `NULLS LAST` where the `mysql` dialect wrote `CAST(... AS ...)` and `CASE WHEN ... IS NULL` sort keys, which changes TPC-H, TPC-DS, TPC-DS OBT, TPC-DI, TPC-Havoc, TPC-H Skew, SSB, AMPLab, ClickBench, H2ODB, CoffeeShop and Read Primitives query text; H2ODB Q9 no longer carries a multi-expression `WITHIN GROUP` sort key. Athena query text is unchanged except that the Metadata Primitives ACL queries, which the catalog already skips on Athena, are now skipped. Athena workload benchmarks keep their primary-key lock bypass, sketch-operation skips and AI Primitives skips under the `athena` name, and SingleStore keeps its Write Primitives overrides, TPC-H named-column-alias expansion, vector type and JoinOrder charset under the `singlestore` name. SingleStore JSON paths write array indexes as integer keypath arguments (`JSON_EXTRACT_JSON(c, 'a', 'preferences', 0)`), as the SingleStore keypath documentation specifies; no SingleStore engine runs in CI, so this is pinned by golden text only.
